Market today: A hawkish Fed outlook and surging 10-year Treasury yields are driving a cautious, bearish mood. This directly pressures your concentrated tech and chip portfolio, especially with margin amplifying any downside.

Your holdings: SOXL (-75.25%), MUU (-60.12%), and SMCI (-36.53%) are your deepest losses, all flagged "SELL." Many of your leveraged positions have stops set above current prices, making them ineffective for downside protection. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield for continued upward pressure and any further developments regarding Nvidia's internal probe.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage risk on your deeply underwater, leveraged positions in this rising rate environment.
plays: Re-evaluate stops on leveraged "SELL" positions: Your stops on SOXL, MUU, PLTU, SPAL, SMCI, and SMH are currently above their market prices, offering no downside protection from here. Adjust these immediately to reflect current risk tolerance.
Consider a hedge: With rising rates pressuring tech, look at SQQQ as a potential long hedge. Scanner shows a setup: entry 43.72-43.67, stop 43.56.
